audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with apocalyptic and prophetic symbolism; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for apocalypse/unveiling, seven assemblies, Alpha/Omega, Son-of-Human vision, fear-not commission.

verses.restored: Unveiling of Jesus Messiah, which the Divine gave him to show his servants what must happen in swiftness, and he signified it, sending through his messenger to his servant John,

familiar.text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

modern.text: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,

original.text: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ, ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει, καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ,

verses.restored: who witnessed the word of the Divine and the witness of Jesus Messiah, as many things as he saw.

familiar.text: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

modern.text: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

original.text: ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅσα εἶδεν.

verses.restored: Blessed is the one reading and those hearing the words of the prophecy and keeping the things written in it, for the season is near.

familiar.text: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

modern.text: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near. John Greets the Seven Churches

original.text: μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα, ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς.

verses.restored: John to the seven assemblies in Asia: grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven Spirits before his throne,

familiar.text: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

modern.text: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,

original.text: Ἰωάννης ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ⸀ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: and from Jesus Messiah, the trustworthy witness, firstborn of the dead, and ruler of kings of earth; to the One loving us and releasing us from our sins/misalignments in his blood/life,

familiar.text: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

modern.text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,

original.text: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός, ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς. Τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ ⸀λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ⸀ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ—

verses.restored: and making us a reign, priests to his Divine and Father, to him be glory and might into the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

modern.text: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

original.text: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν, ἱερεῖς τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ— αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ⸂τῶν αἰώνων⸃· ἀμήν.

verses.restored: Look, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him, and all tribes of earth will mourn over him. Yes, amen.

familiar.text: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

modern.text: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.

original.text: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν, καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν, καὶ κόψονται ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς. ναί, ἀμήν.

verses.restored: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says Lord Divine, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.

familiar.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

modern.text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega, ” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty. John’s Vision on Patmos

original.text: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, λέγει κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ὁ παντοκράτωρ.

verses.restored: I, John, your sibling and partner in the pressure and reign and endurance in Jesus, came to be on the island called Patmos because of the word of the Divine and witness of Jesus.

familiar.text: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

modern.text: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.

original.text: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης, ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ⸀συγκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ⸀ἐν Ἰησοῦ, ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ⸀καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ⸀Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: I came to be in Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a great voice like trumpet,

familiar.text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

modern.text: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

original.text: ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ ἤκουσα ⸂ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν⸃ μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος

verses.restored: saying: What you see, write into a scroll and send to the seven assemblies: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.

familiar.text: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

modern.text: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”

original.text: λεγούσης· Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις, εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν.

verses.restored: And I turned to see the voice speaking with me, and turning I saw seven golden lampstands,

familiar.text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

modern.text: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

original.text: ⸀Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετʼ ἐμοῦ· καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς,

verses.restored: and in midst of the lampstands one like son of human, clothed with a robe reaching to feet and girded at the chest with golden sash.

familiar.text: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

modern.text: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.

original.text: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ ⸀τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον ⸀υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου, ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν·

verses.restored: His head and hairs were white like wool, like snow, and his eyes like flame of fire,

familiar.text: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

modern.text: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.

original.text: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν, ὡς χιών, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός,

verses.restored: and his feet like burnished bronze refined in furnace, and his voice like sound of many waters.

familiar.text: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

modern.text: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.

original.text: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ, ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ ⸀πεπυρωμένης, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν,

verses.restored: And having in his right hand seven stars, and from his mouth a sharp two-edged sword going out, and his face like sun shining in its power.

familiar.text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

modern.text: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

original.text: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ ⸂χειρὶ αὐτοῦ⸃ ἀστέρας ἑπτά, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead; and he placed his right hand on me, saying: Do not fear. I am first and last,

familiar.text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

modern.text: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,

original.text: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν, ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός· καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ ἐμὲ λέγων· Μὴ φοβοῦ· ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος,

verses.restored: and the Living One; and I became dead, and look, I am living into the ages of ages, and I have keys of Death and Hades.

familiar.text: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

modern.text: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.

original.text: καὶ ὁ ζῶν— καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν ⸀αἰώνων— καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου.

verses.restored: Therefore write what you saw, and what is, and what is about to happen after these things.

familiar.text: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

modern.text: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.

original.text: γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει ⸀γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.

verses.restored: The mystery of the seven stars you saw upon my right hand and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are messengers of the seven assemblies, and the seven lampstands are seven assemblies.

familiar.text: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

modern.text: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

original.text: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων ⸀οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς· οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.

translation_notes: Apokalypsis is unveiling, not disaster genre.
Sword from mouth is symbolic word/judgment imagery, not literal violence.
Revelation opens as witness under empire-pressure, not a codebook for modern target-mapping.
safety_note: Revelation must be read as symbolic apocalyptic resistance literature centered on the Lamb, not as fearmongering, hate, or violent fantasy.
